The Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques King Fahd bin Abdulaziz Al Saud Mosque in the city of Muzaffarabad is a gift from the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia to the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, following the devastating earthquake that struck parts of Pakistan on October 8, 2005.
Description
The mosque can accommodate more than six thousand worshippers and features spacious courtyards with designs inspired by the Masjid al-Haram and the Al-Masjid an-Nabawi.
